title: Grateful Dead Live at Euphoria Ballroom on 1970-07-16

ai_review.summary: Excellent Janis‑Pigpen Lovelight jam captured on a crisp yet slightly hissy audience tape with great overall sound
ai_review.review: The show is celebrated for the once‑in‑a‑lifetime Janis Joplin and Pigpen collaboration on “Lovelight,” plus early highlights like “Candyman” and a brief “China Cat Sunflower / I Know You Rider.” Reviewers rave about the energy, vocal interplay and even Jerry Garcia’s sexy guitar work, while noting the recording is generally clear with some tape hiss from an audience‑sourced cassette.

ai_rating.rationale: Uniformly enthusiastic 4‑5 star reviews praising both performance and sound; many detailed comments give a clear picture of an outstanding show despite minor tape hiss.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp but slightly hissy cassette tape; reviewers call the sound great, crisp and “astounding,” though a few note tape hiss and that it is a direct transfer from the original cassette.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early “Candyman” and a quick “China Cat Sunflower / I Know You Rider” tease set the stage, leading into the centerpiece – an electrifying Janis‑Pigpen Lovelight jam that dominates reviewer commentary.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is highlighted as sexy and powerful, especially during the early “Candyman” segment and the Lovelight interaction.
